title: trisetum trinii var. majus
intro: Trisetum trinii var. majus, commonly known as Big Tufted Hair Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to the mountainous regions of East Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-boosting properties, making it a potential remedy for various ailments such as fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Trisetum trinii var. majus are attributed to its ability to tonify the lungs, clear heat, and resolve toxins, as well as its antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit significant pharmacological activities.
